newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ROBSON PRAISES FIGO FOR TOP PERFORMANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON PRAISES FIGO FOR TOP PERFORMANCE.

text.p: Barcelona coach Bobby Robson singled out Portuguese international Luis Figo for special praise after the extra-time 3-2 Spanish Cup final triumph against Real Betis on Saturday.
"I'm very, very happy with the victory. The team showed a lot of spirit," said the former England manager.
"We had a good second half and Luis Figo was very special. He gave an extraordinary performance.
"All the other players fought well -- they gave a great performance and refused to accept defeat."
Robson refused to say whether he would be leaving Barcelona or staying at the club in another managerial role next season.
Ajax coach Louis van Gaal is expected to take over Robson's present position.
"I don't have to leave," said Robson. "It's an exceptional situation (winning two major cups and finishing second in the Spanish League) but it's one I understand -- and I also agreed to it.
"If it's my last game (at Barcelona) then it's a great way to finish. I suppose it's the first time in history something like this has happened -- so it seems I've made history."
Robson might have decided to continue as first team coach had he managed to win the league rather than finish second to bitter rivals Real Madrid.
"I'd change one of the cups for the league title, but I don't know which one," he said.
Robson praised Real Betis for their part in the thrilling final.
"They played well in the first half. They were very good, very compact," he said.
"Alfonso was always dangerous. We had to play exceptionally well to win a game after being behind twice."
